fullDesc: The Hubble Space Telescope was launched on April 24, 1990. After a flaw in its mirror was found, astronauts fixed it in 1993, and Hubble went on to take some of the most famous images in astronomy.
realFacts: Its Deep Field images showed thousands of galaxies
It helped measure the age and expansion of the universe
It has been serviced several times
The James Webb Telescope succeeded it in 2021
